clips.title: Launch title
clips.alt: A white title card. A wordmark rises into a masked reveal, an accent rule draws in beneath it, the card holds, then fades out.
clips.prompt: A 14s launch title on a white canvas. The wordmark rises into a masked reveal, an accent rule draws in beneath it, the card holds for 2s, then fades out and lifts. Hairline rules top and bottom, one accent, no decoration.

clips.title: Kinetic type
clips.alt: On black, the brief arrives one line at a time: “a 14s launch title”, then “on a white canvas”. The second line is in the accent colour.
clips.prompt: A 9s kinetic title on black. The brief arrives one line at a time — “a 14s launch title”, then “on a white canvas”. The words enter staggered, the second line in the accent colour, they hold, and they leave in reverse. Nothing else on the ground.

clips.title: Product loop
clips.alt: A product turns on a light ground beside a shot list. Text reads “the product, on loop”, then “and the project is editable”.
clips.prompt: A 21s product loop. A product turns on a light ground while a shot list builds beside it in monospaced columns. The card ends on “the product, on loop”, then on “and the project is editable”. One accent, no decoration.

clips.title: Footage + title
clips.alt: A dark moving source clip with a title sequence burned in over the top.
clips.prompt: Cut the first 3s of the source clip, add a title card in our brand type at 0:03, hold over the footage, fade out at 0:14. A headline and a source-in readout, over a moving source.

note: Every clip here was rendered by the skills this product ships. The prompt is the product: it is shown, copyable, and can be pasted straight into ChatGPT with the plugin installed. The source footage in footage-title is a generated stand-in, not customer footage.
